scope: Verified candidate-only explicit reviewed-resolution confirmation UI
behavior: All five field sources and a successful freshness recheck are required before confirmation is available.
Fresh phrase and explicit checkbox confirmation precede any save.
Guarded repository supplies the authenticated namespace; the view cannot choose an account/target.
Atomic save retains original draft and reviewed snapshot/history in an encrypted archive.
Wrong phrase, stale storage after recheck and native archive quota failures retain editing draft and proposal and require another review.
Successful local save clears the editor only after completion and instructs the owner to export/verify a portable bundle.
Default view/controller mounts remain disabled unless explicitly opted in; all three isolated synthetic candidate panels opt in after native workflow verification.
